quarterly_data.quarter: OpenAI press release: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: OpenAI: since ads launched just over eight months ago, over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns on ChatGPT; ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 additional countries (14 more Latin American countries including Argentina, Chile, Colombia and Peru, plus markets across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia), extending availability to 89 countries worldwide. More than 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week. Ads appear only on the Free and Go plans; Plus, Pro and Enterprise remain ad-free.
quarterly_data.figure: over 100,000 advertisers; 26 additional countries; 89 countries; more than 1.2 billion weekly users
